name: Monash Achieving Potential Support Scholarship
summary: Up to $30,000 for commencing Monash undergraduates on a low income or facing financial hardship.
key: $6,000 a year, up to $30,000 in total, with 250 awarded each year.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder.
Commencing undergraduate at a Monash campus in Australia.
Experiencing financial hardship, with low income required.
how: VTAC applicants apply through the VTAC equity schemes (SEAS) to be considered automatically.

evidence.quote: $6000 per annum (48 credit points of study)
